description: Maintenance job type (Story 35.5, hole 85, CAP-10): the sandbox-tier sibling of maintenance-conformance, which stays a host core job. The tk-studio-evals surface runs claude plugin eval for the plugin's eval cases the host cannot run (they need a shell and the repository tree), writes <out>/<case>.json and <out>/scores.json (in the VM's run workspace), and ends in a status block whose artifacts list scores.json and whose reason is the per-case summary; finish lands it in the host run's run.json and the run's job-run ledger line carries it. One-shot: the operator queues it once.
